title: Hopf charge and coercive energy bounds
question: For a normalized two-component field on compactified three-space, determine sharp lower bounds on a fixed Skyrme-type energy in each Hopf class.
first_test: Prove a charge-dependent inequality and characterize possible equality.

title: Knot type versus Hopf degree
question: Determine whether two stationary knotted configurations with equal Hopf degree but different knot type can be connected through finite-energy deformations.
first_test: Give a path or demonstrate an additional conserved invariant.

title: Linked vortex stability
question: For a two-component nonlinear wave model, determine whether a pair of linked vortex rings has an orbitally stable energy minimum.
first_test: Construct a stable linked branch or a destabilizing perturbation.

title: Topology of nodal lines under evolution
question: Determine the conditions under which nodal lines of a smooth complex field can reconnect without loss of PDE regularity.
first_test: Prove a generic reconnection mechanism or a topological exclusion.

title: Minimal energy for fixed winding pair
question: On a two-dimensional torus, minimize a phase-gradient energy within a prescribed pair of integer winding classes.
first_test: Compute the sharp minimum and stability of its representatives.

title: Knotted-field symmetry breaking
question: Determine whether energy-minimizing Hopf configurations must lose rotational symmetry above a threshold topological charge.
first_test: Prove a symmetry-breaking criterion or construct symmetric minimizers.

title: Vector-soliton polarization dynamics
question: For coupled cubic–quintic waves, derive the effective dynamics of relative component polarization near a bound state.
first_test: Prove a modulation equation with quantified errors.

title: Topological obstruction to scalarization
question: Determine whether a two-component wave in a nontrivial topological class can be continuously deformed to a one-component state without crossing zero intensity.
first_test: Prove a homotopy obstruction or construct an admissible deformation.

title: Vortex collision and reconnection energy
question: Quantify the minimal energy barrier for two vortex filaments to reconnect under a specified dissipative geometric flow.
first_test: Prove a lower barrier or an explicit finite-energy path.

title: Topological mode trapping in waveguides
question: For a periodic coupled-mode waveguide with a nontrivial band invariant, determine whether robust localized edge modes survive local defects.
first_test: Establish bulk-boundary correspondence for the exact operator or a counterexample.

title: Higher Hopf-class minimizer compactness
question: Determine whether minimizing sequences in fixed nonzero Hopf class are precompact modulo translations or split into charge-carrying clusters.
first_test: Prove a binding criterion or classify dichotomy.

title: Knotted-wave oscillation spectra
question: For a stationary Hopf soliton, characterize its localized internal vibration frequencies and resonance with ambient waves.
first_test: Derive a spectral stability or radiation-damping theorem.

title: Defect interactions in multicomponent condensates
question: Determine whether fractional vortices in a specified two-component energy are linearly confined or separate at finite energy.

title: Quantization without imposed topology
question: Determine whether a scalar nonlinear wave equation admits isolated conserved integer charges generated dynamically rather than imposed through fixed boundary conditions.
first_test: Construct an invariant or prove all such charges trivial in a restricted class.

title: Topology-preserving numerical schemes
question: Construct a convergent finite-element or spectral discretization that exactly preserves a chosen discrete winding or Hopf invariant.
first_test: Prove convergence and preservation or identify an unavoidable tradeoff.

title: Creation of knot pairs under forcing
question: Determine whether a localized forcing protocol can nucleate two opposite-charge knotted structures while preserving total topological charge.
first_test: Construct a controlled dynamical path or establish an energy obstruction.

title: Topological charge under weak noise
question: For a stochastic geometric field flow with continuous nonvanishing sample paths, determine whether topological charge remains almost surely constant.
first_test: Prove conservation and characterize breakdown when regularity fails.

title: Coupled-field vortex lattice phases
question: Classify periodic vortex-lattice minimizers of a two-component wave energy as coupling and mean density vary.
first_test: Prove a phase-boundary result or construct competing lattice energies.

title: Topology of moduli spaces of confined waves
question: Determine the homotopy type of the family of localized minimizers after quotienting translation and global phase symmetries.
first_test: Compute a moduli-space invariant in a fixed parameter regime.
